title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Crime of Illegally Detaining Another Person to Recover Debts Not Protected by Law

articles.content_en:
Judicial Interpretation [2000] No. 19
For the correct application of the Criminal Law, the interpretation on how to convict the act of illegally detaining another person for the purpose of collecting usurious loans, gambling debts, and other debts not protected by law is as follows:
Where an actor illegally detains or imprisons another person for the purpose of collecting usurious loans, gambling debts, or other debts not protected by law, the actor shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 238 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.
